caption: The drawing depicts a single pinkish-red glass vase centered on a plain, off-white background. The vase is vertically oriented, with a wavy, scalloped opening at the top outlined in a thin, dark line. The body of the vase is elongated and slightly flared at the base, with a subtle hourglass shape. The surface of the vase shows a herringbone or chevron pattern with lighter and darker shades of pink and red, giving it a textured and reflective appearance. The bottom of the vase is rounded and slightly indented. There are no additional objects or decorative elements present in the composition.
title: Ruby Vase
